title: A byte order mark alone on a line between a bare document and an explicit one
notes: After a bare document that is not closed by an end marker, the stream may continue with a byte order mark, comment lines and an explicit document (the alternatives of production 211); the mark's line break is a comment line with no text, since a line still starts after the mark (Example 9.1). Compare `parse/bom-after-bare-document-before-directives-end`, where the start marker follows the mark on the same line.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a byte order mark in front of `---` on the same line but refused one on a line of its own.
